record_measurements_unit_ck.name: record_measurements_unit_ck
record_measurements_unit_ck.value: ("record_measurements"."kind" = 'weight' and "record_measurements"."unit" in ('g', 'kg')) or ("record_measurements"."kind" in ('height', 'width', 'depth', 'diameter') and "record_measurements"."unit" in ('mm', 'cm', 'm'))

records_period_year_ck.name: records_period_year_ck
records_period_year_ck.value: "records"."period_from_year" is null or "records"."period_to_year" is null or "records"."period_from_year" <= "records"."period_to_year"

evidence_anchor_scope_ck.name: evidence_anchor_scope_ck
evidence_anchor_scope_ck.value: ("evidence_anchors"."scope_kind" = 'whole' and "evidence_anchors"."region" is null) or ("evidence_anchors"."scope_kind" = 'region' and "evidence_anchors"."region" is not null)

record_checks_reason_ck.name: record_checks_reason_ck
record_checks_reason_ck.value: ("record_checks"."result_kind" in ('undetermined', 'not_applicable') and nullif(trim("record_checks"."result_reason"), '') is not null) or ("record_checks"."result_kind" not in ('undetermined', 'not_applicable') and "record_checks"."result_reason" is null)

source_locators_branch_ck.name: source_locators_branch_ck
source_locators_branch_ck.value: ("source_locators"."kind" = 'page' and "source_locators"."page_id" is not null and "source_locators"."canonical_view_id" is not null and "source_locators"."url" is null) or ("source_locators"."kind" = 'web' and "source_locators"."url" is not null and "source_locators"."retrieved_at" is not null and "source_locators"."page_id" is null)

source_locators_range_ck.name: source_locators_range_ck
source_locators_range_ck.value: ("source_locators"."range_start" is null and "source_locators"."range_end" is null) or ("source_locators"."block_id" is not null and "source_locators"."range_start" >= 0 and "source_locators"."range_end" > "source_locators"."range_start")
